import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        double minDiff = 1e30;
        long ansA = 0, ansB = 0;
        
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            long a = x * i / y;
            double diff = Math.abs((double)x / y - (double)a / i);
            if (diff < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff;
                ansA = a;
                ansB = i;
            }
            a++;
            diff = Math.abs((double)x / y - (double)a / i);
            if (diff < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diff;
                ansA = a;
                ansB = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ansA + "/" + ansB);
        sc.close();
    }
}
